faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know before starting your project.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: Duration depends on project complexity. A business website takes 2–4 weeks, an online store 4–8 weeks, and a landing page 1–2 weeks.

items.question: What is included in the project price?
items.answer: The price includes custom design, full development, basic SEO optimization, cross-browser testing, admin training, and 30 days of post-launch support.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.answer: Yes, we offer monthly maintenance packages that include security updates, backups, performance monitoring, and minor content changes.

items.question: Are the websites optimized for mobile?
items.answer: Absolutely. All our projects are 100% responsive and tested on all devices — from phone to 4K desktop.

items.question: Can I track project progress?
items.answer: Yes, you'll have access to a dashboard where you can track progress in real time, approve designs, and communicate directly with the team.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: We use modern technologies such as Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for maximum performance, excellent SEO, and a premium user experience.
